en.name: Flow: Gravity Storm
en.description: Activate the gravity core in one hammer, toss it backwards, let its gravitational pull draw your body backwards, reorient yourself and come smashing down where you please.
en.command: Hold {KeyBind:MoveBack} + {KeyBind:Dash} after Reversal Can be performed alone while Reversal is on cooldown Can be added to a Quick Slot
tooltip: All damage applies Attraction's damage x2
Super Armor at the start of the skill Invincible while concealed Super Armor when character reappears
